source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.3.1, printed page 150.

blocks.text: Law of mass action ke mutabiq reactants ki concentration jitni zyada ho, reaction utni tezi se chalti hai. Jab ek ya zyada reactants ki concentration barhti hai to reaction ki rate barhti hai. Wajah yeh hai ke concentration barhne se react karne wale particles ke darmiyan zyada collisions (takkar) hote hain, aur reaction tez ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Agar reactants gases hon to pressure (dabao) barhane se gases ki concentration barhti hai aur reaction ki rate bhi barh jati hai. Lekin agar reactants solids ya liquids hon to pressure badalne ka rate par koi asar nahi hota.

blocks.alt: Red aur blue particles ke do square boxes (chokor dabbe). Box a) bhara hua hai: bohat se particles aur paanch orange sitare jahan red aur blue particle takrate hain. Box b) mein kahin kam particles aur sirf do collisions hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5: Zyada concentration ki wajah se box a) ki reaction box b) se tez hogi (kitab ki Figure 7.5 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Box a) mein particles zyada hain (zyada concentration), is liye collisions (orange sitare) bhi zyada hain. Box b) mein particles kam hain aur collisions bhi kam; is liye a) wali reaction tez hogi.

blocks.prompt: Hydrogen aur oxygen ke mixture ko dabane (compress karne) se un ki reaction tez kyun hoti hai, jabke solid zinc aur halke acid wale flask ko dabane se nahi?
blocks.explanation: Gases ko dabane se un ke molecules qareeb aa jate hain, concentration aur collisions barh jate hain. Solid aur liquid ka volume pressure se taqreeban nahi badalta, is liye zinc aur acid ki concentration aur collisions wahi rehte hain.

items: Zyada concentration → zyada collisions → tez reaction.
Gases mein zyada pressure ka matlab zyada concentration; solids aur liquids par pressure ka asar nahi.
